svg.text: Which of two compounds does this target prefer?
One target, held fixed. Both readings are Kd, so the comparison is endpoint matched.
The model is given only the two structures and the target sequence. It never sees a measured value.
Correct. Inobrodib is active at a concentration 4.62 log units lower than Molibresib here.
Held out: neither compound appeared anywhere in the training set. Accuracy in this strength band is 0.919 on 11,435 comparisons.
